set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 2eb0dc755a4da8d5881c1dd873b11bf5807ae483; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('apps/mobile/src/screens/devices/SavedPlugCard.tsx')
s = p.read_text()
old = "  const climateRuntime =\n    climateRule && ruleSnapshot && 'mode' in ruleSnapshot ? ruleSnapshot : null;"
new = "  const climateRuntime =\n    climateRule &&\n    ruleSnapshot &&\n    'mode' in ruleSnapshot &&\n    'scriptMatch' in ruleSnapshot &&\n    'modeSupported' in ruleSnapshot\n      ? ruleSnapshot\n      : null;"
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('expected narrowing snippet not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
PY
pnpm exec prettier --write apps/mobile/src/flows/rules/useClimateRuleDiagnostics.ts apps/mobile/src/screens/devices/SavedPlugCard.tsx; git diff --check; git add apps/mobile/src/flows/rules/useClimateRuleDiagnostics.ts apps/mobile/src/screens/devices/SavedPlugCard.tsx; git -c user.name='Local Agent' -c user.email='local-agent@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'Fix plug card runtime narrowing'; git push origin HEAD:work/device-rule-decoupling-20260913; git status --short
